layman_headline: Market fear is running high — no clear trade setups worth the risk right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood, with the Fear & Greed Index at 28 and trending worse over the past week. Bitcoin is down about 1.5% over seven days and most altcoins are showing weakness. The swing trade candidates today are either already overbought after big runs (BTW, UB), in steep freefall without clear bottoms (BEAT), stuck in bearish downtrends (TRUMP, MON), or just neutral without any compelling catalyst (AAVE, WLD). None of them offer a clean setup with a good risk-reward ratio and a reliable stop-loss.
layman_action: Stay patient and keep your cash ready. The market hasn't found a bottom yet, and jumping in during this kind of fear without a clear setup is how losses happen. Wait for a better entry.
expert_reasoning: Systematic review of all 7 candidates: BTW is overbought (RSI 69) after a 30% daily surge with terrible 0.29x risk/reward — classic chasing setup. UB has no technical data at all and is up 60% in a week, pure momentum chase. BEAT shows deeply conflicting data between its chart analysis ($3.54 uptrend) and actual price ($2.76, -28.7% daily), suggesting either a data error or extreme volatility that makes stops unreliable. TRUMP has the best RSI reading (26, oversold) per our validated signal credibility, but the chart is bearish (-0.70 bias), it's below all MAs, and the 98% drawdown from ATH suggests structural decline rather than a bounce opportunity. MON is approaching oversold (RSI 34) but in a confirmed downtrend with bearish chart bias. AAVE and WLD are neutral with no catalysts. The Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend, combined with macro concerns (yen intervention, Clarity Act risk per Bernstein), makes this an environment to preserve capital.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 28 and worsening — markets could deteriorate further before any bounce materializes
Yen carry trade unwinding could trigger broader risk-off moves that hit crypto especially hard
Bernstein warns of another leg lower if the Clarity Act stalls, adding regulatory uncertainty
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for a drop below 25 (extreme fear) or a reversal back above 35 as potential turning point
Bitcoin price action around $62,000-$63,000 support — a decisive break lower would signal more pain across altcoins
ADA momentum — up 20.7% in 7 days against a bearish market, may present a swing setup if it pulls back to support
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear-driven consolidation phase with BTC at $63,844 and most altcoins bleeding. Macro headwinds from potential yen intervention and regulatory uncertainty (Clarity Act) are keeping risk appetite suppressed.
context_banner: Fear dominates with no clean swing setups — capital preservation is the highest-conviction play until the market stabilizes.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening weekly trend (avg 27.6) signals persistent market anxiety — not ideal for new entries without strong technical confirmation.
